We are pleased to announce that the January 2026 edition of our digital newsletter "Utsukushii Hoshi" (Beautiful Star) has been published.

■Latest Edition of Digital Newsletter "Utsukushii Hoshi"

We also share information through our official LINE account and X (formerly Twitter).

When a new edition of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry newsletter is released, you will receive a notification on the publication date if you register your email address or add our LINE official account as a friend. Please sign up.

※Email registration is limited to member businesses of our Chamber. Thank you for your understanding.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2178/
